name: omnisearch
description: Universal multi-provider web search: MCP server + native plugin wrappers for OpenCode and Kilocode

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/mcp-server && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/opencode-plugin && tsc -p packages/kilocode-plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/mcp-server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/opencode-plugin && tsc --noEmit -p packages/kilocode-plugin
